Horace Canary Wharf: Grooming and fragrances for men. 
Horace provides men with everything they need to look good, smell good and be themselves. Made in France, Horace is renowned for its unbeatable value for money. Whether you’re looking for your signature fragrance or perfecting your pre-office routine, Horace develops products alongside its community to meet real needs, inclusively and without the fuss. From skincare and beard care to deodorants, every essential is designed for maximum efficiency. In your Horace Canary Wharf shop, come and try all our products and get expert advice from our ever-welcoming team.
